def VTask.binaryRec {motive : ℕ → Sort u} (zero : motive 0) (bit : (b : Bool) → (n : ℕ) → motive n → motive (Nat.bit b n)) (n : ℕ) : motive n := by
  have h_main : ∀ (n : ℕ), motive n := by
    intro n
    induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h n ih =>
      match n with
      | 0 =>
        -- Base case: n = 0
        exact zero
      | 1 =>
        -- Inductive step: n = 1
        have h₁ : motive (Nat.bit true 0) := by
          have h₂ := ih 0 (by decide)
          have h₃ := ih 0 (by decide)
          simpa [Nat.bit] using bit true 0 zero
        simpa [Nat.bit] using h₁
      | k + 2 =>
        -- Inductive step: n = k + 2
        have h₁ := ih (k + 1) (by omega)
        have h₂ := ih (k + 1) (by omega)
        have h₃ := ih (k + 1) (by omega)
        have h₄ := ih (k + 1) (by omega)
        -- Use the bit function to compute the value for n = k + 2
        have h₅ : (k + 2) % 2 = 0 ∨ (k + 2) % 2 = 1 := by omega
        cases h₅ with
        | inl h₅ =>
          -- Case: (k + 2) % 2 = 0
          have h₆ : (k + 2) = Nat.bit false ((k + 2) / 2) := by
            have h₇ : (k + 2) % 2 = 0 := h₅
            have h₈ : (k + 2) = 2 * ((k + 2) / 2) := by
              omega
            rw [h₈]
            simp [Nat.bit, h₇]
            <;> omega
          have h₇ := bit false ((k + 2) / 2) (ih ((k + 2) / 2) (by omega))
          simpa [h₆] using h₇
        | inr h₅ =>
          -- Case: (k + 2) % 2 = 1
          have h₆ : (k + 2) = Nat.bit true ((k + 2) / 2) := by
            have h₇ : (k + 2) % 2 = 1 := h₅
            have h₈ : (k + 2) = 2 * ((k + 2) / 2) + 1 := by
              omega
            rw [h₈]
            simp [Nat.bit, h₇]
            <;> omega
          have h₇ := bit true ((k + 2) / 2) (ih ((k + 2) / 2) (by omega))
          simpa [h₆] using h₇
  exact h_main n
